content.text: Officers were called to Lawford Road shortly after 21:15 BST on Friday by the ambulance service after the man was stabbed in Sturdee Road.
Det Sgt Adrian Davies: It was still light at that time and with the weather being very warm there were probably quite a few people who were in the area or in their gardens.
Police said two men aged 22 and a 24-year-old woman have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder and remained in custody.
PC Aimee Smith: "I'd like to hear from anyone who witnessed this incident or has any information that may help our ongoing inquiries,"
